gap._description: Confirmed missing emissions (probe-verified: the analyzer emits nothing where the spec table requires an emission)

gaps.missing: import edges mislabeled reference_qualified (the tier classifier hardcodes reference_qualified for references, ignoring isImportDep — the JVM-family finding from java's pass) AND the edge source stays the 'root' placeholder (kotlin rewrites to the file's primary type; scala does not — family inconsistency)
gaps.evidence: probe: import java.util.List in class Importer -> 'root->java.util.List [references]/reference_qualified'
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/import-edges) + mutants scala/reclassify-import-tier and scala/drop-import-source-rewrite CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Import edges now carry isImportDep/import_based tier and the source rewrites to the file's primary type, matching kotlin.

gaps.missing: pattern type references lost — case p: Point, case Point(a, b), case s: String emit NO reference to Point/String
gaps.evidence: probe: match { case p: Point => ... } emits only declared_type Int (case-class params) — no reference to Point
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/pattern-refs) + mutant scala/drop-pattern-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). typed_pattern and case_class_pattern now emit pattern_type references (infix_pattern is a binding pattern with no type_identifier — ruled out by probe).

gaps.missing: Foo.bar method values emit no reference to Foo (the callable-reference analog of kotlin K3)
gaps.evidence: probe: xs.map(Foo.bar) emits only apply->map calls
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/method-value-refs) + mutant scala/drop-method-value-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Foo.bar method values now emit a method_value reference to Foo.

gaps.missing: string interpolation s"hi $name" emits no Uses on name (kotlin K4 analog)
gaps.evidence: probe: s"hi $name x${n + 1}" emits no uses edge
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/interp-uses) + mutant scala/drop-expression-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). s"hi $name" now emits Uses on name.

gaps.missing: tuple-typed returns (Int, String) emit no type references (the return-type collector only matches generic_type/type_identifier/functional_type — tuple_type and compound/structural types are missed)
gaps.evidence: probe: def pair(): (Int, String) emits NO references to Int/String
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/tuple-refs) + mutant scala/drop-tuple-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). tuple_type return positions now emit return_type references to the element types.

gaps.missing: derives Show, Hashing emits no references to the derived types
gaps.evidence: probe: case class Person(name: String) derives Show emits no Person->Show reference
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/derives-refs) + mutant scala/drop-derives-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). derives Show, Hashing now emits derives_type references.

gaps.missing: type alias RHS references lost — type Fn = (Int) => String emits the Fn symbol (works) but NO references to Int/String from the alias's own definition
gaps.evidence: probe: type Fn = (Int) => String emits Fn[type] but no Fn->Int / Fn->String
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/type-alias-refs) + mutant scala/drop-type-alias-refs CAUGHT (2026-08-27). type Fn = ... now emits type_alias references to the RHS types.

gaps.missing: field accesses h.value (reads AND writes) emit no Uses on the receiver — scala has no field-access uses collector (only extension methods emit Uses); family gap vs java/groovy/kotlin
gaps.evidence: probe: h.value = h.value + 1 and read(h) = h.value emit zero uses
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/field-uses) + mutant scala/drop-expression-uses CAUGHT (2026-08-27). Field-expression reads AND writes now emit Uses on the receiver (nullary access folded per D3).

gaps.missing: self-type references lost — trait Logging { self: Service => } emits no reference to Service
gaps.evidence: probe: self: Service => emits no reference
gaps.closure: CLOSED — fixture-gated fix (scala/self-type-ref) + mutant scala/drop-self-type-ref CAUGHT (2026-08-27). self: Service => now emits a self_type reference to Service.

decisions.question: a + b infix operator calls: Scala desugars to a.+(b) — a real method call. But operators are overwhelmingly stdlib/primitive (+, *, ::, map...) and there is no symbol table to filter user operators. Recommend: DECLARED LIMITATION (operator calls not emitted as Calls edges).
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION (2026-08-27): infix operator calls are not emitted as Calls edges. Operators are overwhelmingly stdlib/primitive and there is no symbol table to filter user operators — emitting them would flood the graph with noise.

decisions.question: export scala.concurrent.duration.* — the export relationship kind is NOT EMITTED (pattern flag only). Recommend: DECLARED LIMITATION (consistent with kotlin S5 / groovy S3).
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION (2026-08-27): export declarations are NOT EMITTED as export relationships (pattern flag only) — consistent with kotlin S5 / groovy S3.

decisions.question: Parameterless method access without parens (xs.length, s.x) parses as field_expression — method vs field is indistinguishable without a symbol table. Recommend: fold into G8 — emit Uses on the RECEIVER only, never guess the selector kind.
decisions.resolution: RULED (2026-08-27): parameterless/nullary access (xs.length) folds into G8 — emit Uses on the RECEIVER only; the selector kind (method vs field) is never guessed without a symbol table.

decisions.question: XML literals: the grammar declares them but the analyzer ignores them entirely. Recommend: internal_silent (XML literal bodies are out of scope; embedding them would fabricate symbols).
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): XML literals are out of scope; the grammar declares them but the analyzer ignores them — embedding would fabricate symbols.

decisions.question: (1, "a") tuple literal: an expression, not a declaration. Recommend: internal_silent (destructured locals are not symbols — consistent with kotlin S3).
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): tuple literals and destructured locals are not symbols — consistent with kotlin S3.

decisions.question: Scala 3 macros: quote/splice expressions — handleCall already skips callees starting with a quote char (dotty-corpus fix). Recommend: internal_silent (macro AST manipulation is out of scope).
decisions.resolution: INTERNAL SILENT (2026-08-27): Scala 3 macros (quote/splice) — handleCall already skips quoted callees; macro expansion is out of scope.

decisions.node_type: applied_constructor_type, binding, bindings, capture_ref, capture_set, capture_variable, capturing_type, early_defs, error_sentinel, existential_type, given_conditional, identifiers, into_modifier, lazy_parameter_type, named_type_argument, update_modifier, uses_clause, using_directive, using_directive_key, using_directive_value, vararg, while_expression
decisions.question: F6 fixture-coverage gate: these handled_verified entries have no fixture coverage.
decisions.resolution: Probe-verified against the pinned tree-sitter-scala grammar (2026-09-02): no legal Scala source produces these node types — they are grammar-internal supertypes/intermediate nodes (e.g. bindings, identifiers, capture_set/ref/variable, using_directive*, vararg, early_defs, existential_type, given_conditional, error_sentinel, *_bound variants reachable only via wildcard _* splices, update/into/uses modifier forms the grammar never emits). The analyzer contains no literal reference to any of them (grep-verified), so no dead-code risk exists; they are reclassified out of handled_verified.
